mechanism: Both lithium and potassium affect renal handling and electrolyte balance; potassium depletion increases lithium reabsorption and toxicity risk, while hyperkalemia can potentiate cardiac arrhythmias in lithium-treated patients.
action: Monitor serum potassium and lithium levels closely; maintain normal potassium levels and adjust lithium dosing accordingly to avoid toxicity or electrolyte imbalances.
